sens_en: to place, to put, to acquire
origine_fr: Le filet 罒 et 直, qui donne le son (zhí / zhì). Au départ, 置 veut dire relâcher ce qu'on tenait. Relâcher, c'est poser : placer, mettre, acquérir.
origine_en: The net 罒 plus 直, which gives the sound (zhí / zhì). At first, 置 meant letting go of what you held. Letting go is setting down: to place, to put, to acquire.
